title: Closing an e-wallet whose last few pesos cannot be moved: written off as a spend, id close:<account> (decisions Q7 and the Q watch item, P6)
story: Set up Mon 4 Jan 2027 in pesos: the bank holds 20,000.00 and an old e-wallet 3.50, which it will not let anyone send out (below its smallest transfer). On Fri 8 Jan the person closes the e-wallet: the closing writes the 3.50 off as a spend from it, id close:g, so its final figure is zero and it closes. Every amount is made up.

events.note: written off at the closing: it cannot be moved out

asks.question: warnings
asks.why: The e-wallet is closed at zero: nothing is refused and nothing more is due from it.
